calls.statement:
WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS d, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS v
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
), agg AS (
  SELECT store_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' THEN v END) AS fy2526,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-06' AND DATE '2026-10-04' THEN v END) AS t52,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-10-04' THEN v END) AS ytd,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d BETWEEN DATE '2024-04-29' AND DATE '2025-04-27' THEN v END) AS fy2425,
    MAX(d) AS maxd
  FROM net_lines GROUP BY 1)
SELECT a.store_id, cs.store_name, cs.format, cs.sqm, ROUND(fy2526) fy2526, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fy2526 DESC) r_fy, ROUND(t52) t52, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t52 DESC) r_t52, ROUND(ytd) ytd, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ytd DESC) r_ytd, ROUND(fy2425) fy2425, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fy2425 DESC) r_2425, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.sqm DESC) r_sqm, maxd
FROM agg a JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=a.store_id AND cs.is_current
ORDER BY r_fy

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS d, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS v
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
), mine AS (
  SELECT store_id, SUM(v) AS mine FROM net_lines WHERE d BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (
  SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) AS ctl FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2026-05-03' AND store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT m.store_id, ROUND(mine,2) mine, ROUND(ctl,2) ctl, ROUND(mine-ctl,2) gap, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ctl DESC) r_ctl
FROM mine m JOIN ctl c ON c.store_id=m.store_id ORDER BY r_ctl

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT s.store_id, MIN(f.sale_date) mind, MAX(f.sale_date) maxd, COUNT(*) n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) n_receipts, SUM(f.net_amount) net, MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) l1, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) l2, COUNT(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) nload
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
GROUP BY 1

WITH d AS (
  SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1 )
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN d USING (receipt_id, line_no) ORDER BY receipt_id, line_no, sales_line_id LIMIT 12

WITH x AS (
  SELECT f.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no) c
  FROM fact_sales_line f)
SELECT c, rn, COUNT(*) n, SUM(net_amount) net FROM x WHERE c>1 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-04-28' AS start_date, DATE '2026-05-03' AS end_date   -- FY2025/26, weeks 1-53
),
sales_dedup AS (
    -- drop the exact second copy of lines loaded twice (store 116, 15-21 Sep 2025)
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT f.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.receipt_id, f.line_no ORDER BY f.sales_line_id) AS copy_no
        FROM fact_sales_line f) WHERE copy_no = 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM sales_dedup f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_sales AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, ROUND(ss.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current
QUALIFY RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales DESC) <= 10
ORDER BY rank
